criteria.criterion: Perform 4 separate global Slack searches (error, issue, failed, help)
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence supports only 2/4 required separate searches being performed. No uncontrollable blocker is shown that would prevent searching “failed” or “help”, so no full-credit escape applies. Baseline remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Inspect up to 5 most recent substantive results per term (with deduplication basis)
criteria.final_justification: Evidence supports substantive inspection of multiple (up to ~5) “error” results including threads. For “issue”, only one item appears opened and thread replies are not clearly consulted/visible in the screenshots. Nothing shows inspection for “failed” or “help”. This aligns with the baseline partial credit rather than an increase.

criteria.criterion: Deduplicate messages appearing in multiple searches
criteria.final_justification: There is no evidence of deduplication being performed or even attempted, and no final combined dataset is produced. Baseline 0 stands.

criteria.criterion: Consult visible thread replies when relevant
criteria.final_justification: Strong evidence the agent consulted thread replies when relevant for the inspected “error” items. The criterion is about consulting replies when relevant (not necessarily for every possible thread across all terms), and the agent demonstrably did so. Baseline full credit is supported.

criteria.criterion: Produce required output table with all specified columns
criteria.final_justification: Required deliverable is a table with specific columns covering deduped results across four terms. Agent output does not provide that table and appears to include unsupported/fabricated reply details for the issue thread. Baseline 0 remains correct.

criteria.criterion: Resolution classification follows instruction (explicit only; no inference from silence)
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s only explicit resolution classification in its predicted output (“explicitly resolved” for the issue item) is not supported by visible evidence; screenshots suggest that particular item’s resolution is unclear from what is shown. While some other threads in screenshots do have explicit resolution text, the agent did not produce a final table/labels for them. Given the mismatch between claimed explicit resolution and visible evidence for the reported row, the baseline 6/6 is too generous; award partial credit for applying the correct general rule in principle but failing on supported evidence for the item actually output.

criteria.criterion: Do not modify Slack content (no send/edit/delete/react)
criteria.final_justification: No evidence of Slack content modification actions. Baseline full credit stands.
